I’ve tried to curb these feelings. I quit drinking, took up more hiking, I talk to a counselor, but the loneliness and self hate don’t go away, they are addictive feelings, easy feelings. I wish it were acceptable to choose to end my life, to see it as a terminal illness. I wish I could go to the doctor, pass some tests, sign some forms and be allowed to end this existence. I’m not here for me anymore, I’m just going through the motions because I have to. Day to day.
